correctness.rationale: All selected same-part pairs have geodesics of length 2, obstructed only if all unselected opposite vertices are distinct deleted partners of the pair, exactly the predicates p>=2,s<=2,x-c=s and q>=2,r<=2,y-c=r. Selected deleted cross-pairs have geodesic length 3 and need two omitted opposite-class vertices joined by an edge, excluding r=0,s=0 or r=s=e=1. The five occupation parameters x,y,c,u,v partition all subsets and their multinomial weights without duplicates. Exhausting exactly two omitted vertices gives maximum a+b-2 and exact leading coefficient (a-t)(b-t)+1_{t=1}(1+2 1_{a=3}+2 1_{b=3}). Independently rebuilt graphs and BFS for 1984 vertex subsets across five profiles, matching full coefficient distribution and leading counts (51/9,89/2,184/1,422/6,850/4).
residual_risks: Independent check tests only five parameter profiles; all a,b,t conclusion derives from pairwise geodesic cases and multinomial partition.
